wif_ue_move_AL = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_party = 1 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL = wif_ue_amt }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL = wif_ue_amt }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_ue_lean_AL min = 0 max = 100 }
}
# Fence state counted: Democratic if the lean is below a random line 40-60.
wif_ue_resolve_AL = {
	set_temp_variable = { r = random }
	multiply_temp_variable = { r = 20 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { r = 40 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL < r } }
		set_variable = { wif_ue_win_AL = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_ue_win_AL = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_ue_pending_AL = 0 }
	subtract_from_variable = { wif_ue_pending_count = 1 }
}

		subtract_from_variable = { wif_ue_lean_HI = wif_ue_amt }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { wif_ue_lean_HI = wif_ue_amt }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_ue_lean_HI min = 0 max = 100 }
}
# Fence state counted: Democratic if the lean is below a random line 40-60.
wif_ue_resolve_HI = {
	set_temp_variable = { r = random }
	multiply_temp_variable = { r = 20 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { r = 40 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_HI < r } }
		set_variable = { wif_ue_win_HI = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_ue_win_HI = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_ue_pending_HI = 0 }
	subtract_from_variable = { wif_ue_pending_count = 1 }
}

wif_ue_tally = {
	set_variable = { wif_ue_t1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_t2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_t3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_t4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_t5 = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL < 20 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t1 = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL < 40 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t2 = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL > 60 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t3 = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AL > 80 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t4 = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t5 = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AZ < 20 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t1 = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AZ < 40 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t2 = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AZ > 60 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t3 = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AZ > 80 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t4 = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t5 = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AR < 20 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t1 = wif_ue_ev_AR } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AR < 40 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t2 = wif_ue_ev_AR } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AR > 60 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t3 = wif_ue_ev_AR } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AR > 80 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t4 = wif_ue_ev_AR } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t5 = wif_ue_ev_AR } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CA < 20 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t1 = wif_ue_ev_CA } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CA < 40 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t2 = wif_ue_ev_CA } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CA > 60 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t3 = wif_ue_ev_CA } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CA > 80 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t4 = wif_ue_ev_CA } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t5 = wif_ue_ev_CA } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CO < 20 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t1 = wif_ue_ev_CO } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CO < 40 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t2 = wif_ue_ev_CO } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CO > 60 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t3 = wif_ue_ev_CO } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_CO > 80 } } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t4 = wif_ue_ev_CO } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_t5 = wif_ue_ev_CO } }

wif_ue_count_seats = {
	set_variable = { wif_ue_house_d = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_house_r = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_sen_d = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_sen_r = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { h = wif_ue_ev_AL }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h = 2 }

# Vanilla's Congress variables = seats held by the president's party.
wif_ue_sync = {
	set_variable = { representatives_total = wif_ue_house_d }
	add_to_variable = { representatives_total = wif_ue_house_r }
	set_variable = { senators_total = wif_ue_sen_d }
	add_to_variable = { senators_total = wif_ue_sen_r }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pres = 2 } }
		set_variable = { representatives_support = wif_ue_house_r }
		set_variable = { senators_support = wif_ue_sen_r }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { representatives_support = wif_ue_house_d }
		set_variable = { senators_support = wif_ue_sen_d }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_ue_house_pct = representatives_support }
	multiply_variable = { wif_ue_house_pct = 100 }
	divide_variable = { wif_ue_house_pct = representatives_total }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_sen_pct = senators_support }
	multiply_variable = { wif_ue_sen_pct = 100 }
	divide_variable = { wif_ue_sen_pct = senators_total }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_house_need = representatives_total }
	divide_variable = { wif_ue_house_need = 2 }
	round_variable = wif_ue_house_need
	USA_congress_get_quorum = yes
}

# The Democratic AI picks a state group: fence x3, the other party's leaning states x2,
# its own leaning states x1, the other party's strongholds x0.3; never its own strongholds.
# Weighted by electoral votes, x0.7-1.3 at random. Result: temp wif_ue_pick.
wif_ue_ai_pick_d = {
	set_temp_variable = { best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_pick = 0 }
	# Alabama

wif_ue_ai_start_d = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_excl = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_d < wif_ue_ai_cap } }
		wif_ue_ai_pick_d = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pick > 0 } }
			set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_d_a = wif_ue_pick }
			add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_d = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_excl = wif_ue_pick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_d < wif_ue_ai_cap } }
		wif_ue_ai_pick_d = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pick > 0 } }
			set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_d_b = wif_ue_pick }
			add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_d = 1 }
		}
	}
}
# The Republican AI picks a state group: fence x3, the other party's leaning states x2,
# its own leaning states x1, the other party's strongholds x0.3; never its own strongholds.
# Weighted by electoral votes, x0.7-1.3 at random. Result: temp wif_ue_pick.
wif_ue_ai_pick_r = {
	set_temp_variable = { best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_pick = 0 }
	# Alabama
	set_temp_variable = { s = 0 }

wif_ue_ai_start_r = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_excl = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_r < wif_ue_ai_cap } }
		wif_ue_ai_pick_r = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pick > 0 } }
			set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_r_a = wif_ue_pick }
			add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_r = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_excl = wif_ue_pick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_r < wif_ue_ai_cap } }
		wif_ue_ai_pick_r = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pick > 0 } }
			set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_r_b = wif_ue_pick }
			add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_r = 1 }
		}
	}
}
# AI campaigns started last month land now.
wif_ue_ai_flush = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_slot_d_a > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_gidx = wif_ue_slot_d_a }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_party = 1 }
		wif_ue_roll_amount = yes
		wif_ue_sway_index = yes
		set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_d_a = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_slot_d_b > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_gidx = wif_ue_slot_d_b }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_party = 1 }
		wif_ue_roll_amount = yes
		wif_ue_sway_index = yes
		set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_d_b = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_slot_r_a > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_gidx = wif_ue_slot_r_a }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_party = 2 }
		wif_ue_roll_amount = yes
		wif_ue_sway_index = yes
		set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_r_a = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_slot_r_b > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_gidx = wif_ue_slot_r_b }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_party = 2 }
		wif_ue_roll_amount = yes
		wif_ue_sway_index = yes
		set_variable = { wif_ue_slot_r_b = 0 }
	}
	wif_ue_tally = yes
}
wif_ue_roll_amount = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_amt = random }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_ue_amt = 5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_ue_amt = 15 }
}
# Monthly while a campaign is open: last month's AI campaigns land, new ones
# start (2 at a time per AI-run party). A human USA leaves its own party alone;
# an AI USA runs both.
wif_ue_ai_tick = {
	wif_ue_ai_flush = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_player = 1 } }
				}
			}
			wif_ue_ai_start_d = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					NOT = { check_variable = { wif_ue_player = 2 } }
				}
			}
			wif_ue_ai_start_r = yes
		}
	}
}

wif_ue_install_fdr_d = {
	set_party_name = { ideology = democratic long_name = wif_ue_party_d_long name = wif_ue_party_d }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_leader = { character = USA_franklin_delano_roosevelt ruling_only = yes } } }
		promote_character = USA_franklin_delano_roosevelt
	}
	set_variable = { wif_ue_president = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_pres = 1 }
}
wif_ue_install_truman_d = {
	set_party_name = { ideology = democratic long_name = wif_ue_party_d_long name = wif_ue_party_d }
	create_country_leader = {
		name = "Harry S. Truman"
		desc = wif_ue_cand_truman_desc
		picture = GFX_portrait_Harry_S_Truman
		expire = "1975.1.1"
		ideology = liberalism
		traits = { }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_ue_president = 2 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_pres = 1 }
}

wif_ue_install_nominee_d = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 1 } } wif_ue_install_fdr_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 2 } } wif_ue_install_truman_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 3 } } wif_ue_install_eisenhower_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 4 } } wif_ue_install_landon_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 5 } } wif_ue_install_willkie_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 6 } } wif_ue_install_dewey_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 7 } } wif_ue_install_macarthur_d = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 8 } } wif_ue_install_stevenson_d = yes }
}
wif_ue_install_nominee_r = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 2 } } wif_ue_install_truman_r = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 3 } } wif_ue_install_eisenhower_r = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 4 } } wif_ue_install_landon_r = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 5 } } wif_ue_install_willkie_r = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 6 } } wif_ue_install_dewey_r = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 7 } } wif_ue_install_macarthur_r = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 8 } } wif_ue_install_stevenson_r = yes }
}

wif_ue_start_1936 = {
	set_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1936
	set_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1936 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_kind = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_cls = 2 }
	wif_ue_census_1930 = yes
	set_variable = { wif_ue_cost = 20 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ai_cap = 4 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_d = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ai_used_r = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_active = 0 }
	set_country_flag = wif_ue_open
	clr_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
	set_variable = { wif_ue_nom_d = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_nom_r = 4 }
	wif_ue_count_seats = yes
	wif_ue_tally = yes
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		country_event = { id = wif_ue.2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { wif_ue_player = 0 } }
}

# on_daily_USA
wif_ue_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_on }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1936 }
				date > 1935.11.3
				date < 1936.11.3
			}
			wif_ue_start_1936 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1938 }
				date > 1938.5.8
				date < 1938.11.8
			}
			wif_ue_start_1938 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1940 }
				date > 1939.11.5
				date < 1940.11.5
			}
			wif_ue_start_1940 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1942 }
				date > 1942.5.3
				date < 1942.11.3
			}
			wif_ue_start_1942 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1944 }
				date > 1943.11.7
				date < 1944.11.7
			}
			wif_ue_start_1944 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1946 }
				date > 1946.5.5
				date < 1946.11.5
			}
			wif_ue_start_1946 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1948 }
				date > 1947.11.2
				date < 1948.11.2
			}
			wif_ue_start_1948 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1950 }
				date > 1950.5.7
				date < 1950.11.7
			}
			wif_ue_start_1950 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1952 }
				date > 1951.11.4
				date < 1952.11.4
			}
			wif_ue_start_1952 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_started_1954 }
				date > 1954.5.2
				date < 1954.11.2
			}
			wif_ue_start_1954 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_open }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1936 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1936.10.4 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1936.11.3 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1938 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1938.10.9 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1938.11.8 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1940 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1940.10.6 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1940.11.5 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1942 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1942.10.4 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1942.11.3 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1944 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1944.10.8 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1944.11.7 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1946 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1946.10.6 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1946.11.5 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1948 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1948.10.3 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1948.11.2 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1950 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1950.10.8 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1950.11.7 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1952 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1952.10.5 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1952.11.4 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_year = 1954 } }
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1954.10.3 NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_closing } }
					set_country_flag = wif_ue_closing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { date > 1954.11.2 }
					wif_ue_election_day = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_counting }
			wif_ue_count_day = yes
		}
		# Roosevelt dies at Warm Springs if he is still president.
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1945.4.11
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_fdr_died }
				check_variable = { wif_ue_president = 1 }
				has_country_leader = { character = USA_franklin_delano_roosevelt ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_ue_fdr_died
			country_event = { id = wif_ue.30 }
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_in_AK }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AK < 40 } } set_variable = { wif_ue_win_AK = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_AK > 60 } } set_variable = { wif_ue_win_AK = 2 } }
		else = { set_variable = { wif_ue_pending_AK = 1 } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_pending_count = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_in_HI }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_HI < 40 } } set_variable = { wif_ue_win_HI = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_lean_HI > 60 } } set_variable = { wif_ue_win_HI = 2 } }
		else = { set_variable = { wif_ue_pending_HI = 1 } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_pending_count = 1 } }
	}
	set_country_flag = wif_ue_counting
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_count < 1 } }
		wif_ue_finalize = yes
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = wif_ue.20 }
	}
}
# Every day of the count each uncalled fence state has a chance to be called.
wif_ue_count_day = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_AL = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_AL = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_AZ = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_AZ = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_AR = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_AR = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_CA = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_CA = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_CO = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_CO = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_CT = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_CT = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_DE = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_DE = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_FL = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_FL = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_GA = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_GA = yes } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_IL = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_IL = yes } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_AK = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_AK = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_HI = 1 } } random = { chance = 25 wif_ue_resolve_HI = yes } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_pending_count < 1 } }
		wif_ue_finalize = yes
	}
}
wif_ue_finalize = {
	clr_country_flag = wif_ue_counting
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_AL = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_AL } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_AZ = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_AZ } }

	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_UT } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_VT = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_VT } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_VT } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_VA = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_VA } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_VA } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_WA = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_WA } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_WA } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_WV = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_WV } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_WV } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_WI = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_WI } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_WI } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_WY = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_WY } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_WY } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_in_AK }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_AK = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_AK } }
		else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_AK } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_in_HI }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_win_HI = 1 } } add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d = wif_ue_ev_HI } }
		else = { add_to_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r = wif_ue_ev_HI } }
	}
	wif_ue_elect_senate_class = yes
	wif_ue_count_seats = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_kind = 1 } }
		set_variable = { wif_ue_old_pres = wif_ue_pres }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_ev_d > wif_ue_ev_r } }
			wif_ue_install_nominee_d = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_ev_r > wif_ue_ev_d } }
			wif_ue_install_nominee_r = yes
		}
		wif_ue_sync = yes
		wif_ue_tally = yes
		country_event = { id = wif_ue.21 }
	}
	else = {
		wif_ue_sync = yes
		wif_ue_tally = yes
		country_event = { id = wif_ue.22 }
	}
}

# Statehood: 1 House seat and 2 senators, first held by the president's party.
wif_ue_join_AK = {
	set_country_flag = wif_ue_in_AK
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ev_AK = 3 }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_win_AK = wif_ue_pres }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_sc2_AK = wif_ue_pres }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_sc3_AK = wif_ue_pres }
	wif_ue_count_seats = yes
	wif_ue_sync = yes
	wif_ue_tally = yes
}

wif_ue_join_HI = {
	set_country_flag = wif_ue_in_HI
	set_variable = { wif_ue_ev_HI = 3 }

	set_variable = { wif_ue_sc1_HI = wif_ue_pres }
	set_variable = { wif_ue_sc3_HI = wif_ue_pres }

	wif_ue_sync = yes
	wif_ue_tally = yes
}

# on_monthly_USA
wif_ue_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_on }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_open }
			wif_ue_ai_tick = yes
		}
		wif_ue_sync = yes
		wif_ue_tally = yes
	}
}
# The player changes sides (decision, or console "event wif_ue.3").
wif_ue_switch_side = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_ue_player = 2 } }
		set_variable = { wif_ue_player = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_ue_player = 2 }
	}
}
# Player Sway State decision landed (FROM = the state).
wif_ue_player_sway = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_ue_party = wif_ue_player }
	wif_ue_roll_amount = yes
	wif_ue_sway_from = yes
	wif_ue_tally = yes
}
